annotations.summary: API 5xx surge correlated with node disk pressure

evidence: disk_usage probe: /var/lib at 98% (df -h). inode 41%.
db_health probe: Postgres write latency p99 18s, WAL fsync errors in log.
app_log: api-gateway HTTP 500 rate 27% over 3m (upstream timeout).
root_cause: Host partition /var/lib at 98% blocks Postgres WAL fsync, API write handlers time out and return HTTP 500.

proposed_remediation.step: Purge rotated logs/old WAL archives under /var/lib older than 7 days

impact_chain.mechanism: kubelet eviction threshold + Postgres cannot fsync WAL
api-gateway request handlers wait on commit until timeout

evidence: resource probe: z_cpu=4.6 sustained 10m, node load avg 14 on 4 cores.
app_log: checkout p99 latency 9s, 504 gateway timeout rate 12%.
root_cause: Node CPU saturation (z_cpu=4.6) starves checkout worker threads, request latency exceeds gateway timeout producing 504s.

proposed_remediation.step: Scale checkout deployment +2 replicas or raise CPU limit

impact_chain.mechanism: checkout worker threads starved of CPU scheduling slices
impact_chain.effect: request processing latency rises to 9s p99

impact_chain.mechanism: load balancer aborts slow upstream connections

annotations.summary: Memory leak leading to OOMKill and service unavailable

evidence: resource probe: z_mem=5.1, RSS growing linearly +120MB/h over 6h.
state probe: pod reporting-7f9 OOMKilled 4 times, restartCount=4, CrashLoopBackOff.
app_log: reporting endpoint 503 service unavailable during restart windows.
root_cause: Reporting service memory leak drives RSS past the 1Gi limit, kubelet OOMKills the pod repeatedly, causing 503 during restart windows.

verification_steps.rationale: Rule out host memory exhaustion vs pod limit

verification_steps.command: kubectl describe pod -l app=reporting -n multi-agent | grep -A2 'Last State'

proposed_remediation.step: Restart pod to reclaim memory; file bug for leak; consider raising limit as stopgap

impact_chain.cause: reporting service heap leak, z_mem=5.1 rising
impact_chain.mechanism: RSS grows linearly until it crosses the 1Gi kubelet limit
CrashLoopBackOff removes the only ready replica during restart

annotations.summary: Kafka consumer lag causing stale diagnoses

evidence: resource probe: omni-diagnostic-evidence consumer lag 4200 and growing.
state probe: omni-analyst pod Running but LLM semaphore saturated.
app_log: advisory timestamps lag wall-clock by 6m.
root_cause: Analyst LLM throughput below evidence arrival rate, Kafka lag grows to 4200 and advisories become stale by minutes.

verification_steps.command: kubectl logs deploy/omni-fullstack -n multi-agent --tail=100 | grep llm

proposed_remediation.step: Increase analyst LLM concurrency or partition parallelism

impact_chain.cause: LLM inference throughput < evidence arrival rate
impact_chain.mechanism: unconsumed messages accumulate on omni-diagnostic-evidence partitions
advisory generated against evidence minutes old

annotations.summary: Missing ConfigMap crashes nginx, LB returns 502

evidence: state probe: pod nginx CrashLoopBackOff, event 'configmap nginx-config not found'.
app_log: ingress 502 Bad Gateway 100% for nginx route.
root_cause: ConfigMap nginx-config missing prevents nginx container start, all replicas CrashLoopBackOff and the LB returns 502 for the route.

proposed_remediation.step: Recreate nginx-config ConfigMap from manifest, then rollout

impact_chain.mechanism: volume mount fails so nginx container cannot start
ingress has zero healthy upstream endpoints
impact_chain.effect: load balancer returns HTTP 502 for the route

annotations.summary: NFS stale handle forces DB read-only, writes 500

evidence: storage probe: NFS mount /data stale file handle (ESTALE) on db node.
state probe: mysql_health remounted read-only, innodb write errors.
app_log: orders API 500 on POST, GET succeeds.
root_cause: NFS stale file handle on /data forces MySQL into read-only mode, write transactions fail and the orders API returns 500 on POST.

proposed_remediation.step: Remount NFS /data, verify handle, then clear MySQL read-only

impact_chain.cause: NFS mount /data returns stale file handle
impact_chain.mechanism: InnoDB write to the volume fails, MySQL flips read_only
orders API POST handlers get write error from DB driver
impact_chain.effect: POST /orders returns HTTP 500 while GET still works

annotations.summary: Volumetric DDoS saturates CPU and degrades latency

evidence: siem_category=ddos severity=critical: 38k req/s from 12 source IPs.
resource probe: z_cpu=4.9 on edge nodes.
app_log: 503 rate 22% on edge ingress.
root_cause: Volumetric DDoS (38k req/s) saturates edge node CPU, the ingress sheds load and returns 503 to legitimate clients.

verification_steps.rationale: Confirm CPU saturation from request flood
Confirm cluster integrity, no anomalous spawns

proposed_remediation.step: Enable rate limiting / WAF rule for offending IPs at edge

impact_chain.mechanism: request parsing/TLS work saturates edge node CPU
ingress sheds load when worker pool exhausted

evidence: services probe: proxysql_stats backend pool max_connections reached, ConnFree=0.
state probe: mysql backends healthy but ProxySQL queueing.
app_log: api 500 with 'too many connections' from driver.
root_cause: ProxySQL frontend connection pool exhausted (ConnFree=0) queues new sessions until driver timeout, API returns 500 with too-many-connections.

proposed_remediation.step: Raise ProxySQL mysql-max_connections / tune connection multiplexing

impact_chain.mechanism: new client sessions queue past the driver timeout
API request handler raises too-many-connections error

evidence: state probe: omni_llm_up=0 sustained 8m, Ollama endpoint connection refused.
resource probe: omni-diagnostic-evidence lag rising as nothing consumes.
app_log: telegram advisory cards stop arriving.
root_cause: Ollama LLM endpoint unreachable (omni_llm_up=0) halts advisory generation, evidence backlog grows and operators stop receiving advisories.

verification_steps.command: kubectl logs deploy/omni-fullstack -n multi-agent --tail=50 | grep -i ollama

proposed_remediation.step: Restart/verify Ollama host service, confirm model loaded

impact_chain.mechanism: advisory handler cannot run chat inference
evidence messages remain unconsumed on Kafka
impact_chain.effect: consumer lag rises and operator Telegram cards stop

annotations.summary: Auth failure surge triggers account lockouts

evidence: app_log: 401/403 auth_failure rate spiked from 8 to 920 per 5min.
state probe: auth service Running, no resource pressure.
siem_category=auth_anomaly severity=high distributed source IPs.
root_cause: Distributed auth failure surge (920/5min 401/403) trips the lockout policy, legitimate users are locked out as the attack continues.

verification_steps.rationale: Confirm auth failure pattern and sources
Rule out host resource exhaustion from the surge

proposed_remediation.step: Apply IP rate limiting; review lockout threshold; rotate creds if breach confirmed

impact_chain.mechanism: repeated failures hit the per-account lockout threshold
SIEM correlates distributed failures as auth_anomaly
